title: Mary's Mosaic: Mary Pinchot Meyer and JFK
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Mary's Mosaic: Mary Pinchot Meyer and JFK, about 1960s at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there's a there's this book um I think called Mary's Mosaic.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a book he thinks is called Mary's Mosaic, which deals with a woman named Mary Pinchot Meyer and President John F. Kennedy in Washington DC in the 1960s. He brings it up alongside a man named Cord Meyer, as part of a conversation about whether Kennedy knew too much about UFOs, which would matter because it would tie a president's fate to secrets about them.
